name: alcazar-of-segovia
documented_evidence: Official castle architectural history documents the construction and union of tower elements and the final JuanII upper stages/bartizans. Municipal tourism names twelve crowning turrets and quotes80m total tower height.
modeling_qualifications: 80m is not used as above-courtyard wall height because the public description does not define the vertical datum and is incompatible with the photographed tower-to-palace proportions. Above-court31m main wall plus crowns approximates35m; this requires surveyed elevation verification. The tapered plan is fitted to production footprint with26deg bearing. Secondary spires/windows are proportional estimates.
